verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a managed service with a dashboard and API, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product assistant that can take delegated tasks. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes are documentation and developer building blocks, not an assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
